Overnight Anomaly
Introduction
Instead of collecting profit from intraday trading, this algorithm tries to capture the overnight returns of the index.
Method
The strategy buys the SPY ETF at its closing price and sells it at the opening each day.
 The strategy makes a lot of trades, therefore, the whole strategy is very sensitive
 to
slippage costs
and
fees
. Those returns are canceled out once transaction costs are taken into account. With the
InteractiveBrokersFeeModel
, fees for 20
 years backtest is almost 25% of the initial cash.
Reference
Quantpedia - Overnight Anomaly
